item.title: Kon'ya no Okazu wa Range de Marine
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: RUNE
  • 発売日: 2006-08-25
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 今夜のオカズはレンジdeまりね
  • 英語名: Kon’ya no Okazu wa Range de Marine

别名

  • Kon‛＼ya no Okazu wa Renji de Marine

あらすじ

Renji is a uni student, living a peaceful life. One day, he meets two people, one is a princess of the devil world who ran away from the devil world because she doesn’t want to marry him and another one is her fiance. Unfortunately, Renji gets involved in their quarrel… and unknowingly, Renji pretends to be her fiance in the human world. No one notices this will be the dawn of full of H life….

item.title: Ricotte ~Alpenbul no Utahime~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: RUNE
  • 発売日: 2003-09-26
  • スコア: 6.88/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Ricotte ～アルペンブルの歌姫～
  • 英語名: Ricotte Alpenbul no Utahime

别名

  • Ricotte Songstress of Alpenburg

あらすじ

Quark, a once-prosperous airship building town. If people are scarce nowadays, that’s because there are only a few factories still in business.

In a pub in a corner of that declining town is a pianist acting as our protagonist and because of strange circumstances, a young lady calling herself “Ricotte” has ended up living together with him.

Attached is a letter with a duplicate key. Confused, the protagonist opens the trunk and finds a girl sleeping inside…

item.title: Nyante Chaton
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: RUNE
  • 発売日: 2001-07-19
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: にゃんてCHATON
  • 英語名: Nyante Chaton

别名

  • にゃんてシャトン

あらすじ

You’ve been a doing nothing ever since graduating from high school. One summer day, your father, the owner of a famous restaurant, “Chanter Chaton,” orders you to work there. You comply with his orders. “Chanter Chaton” is famous for its taste, the service, and the waitresses’ uniforms. The first floor is a simple cafeteria and the second floor has a very strange feeling to it. This restaurant is so popular; it’s hard to approach the girls. One way of approaching the girls is to help them out when they make mistakes.
